description: Plant zones with the plants you chose — species (productId) or generic plant shapes (shape + size) — the editor places them: in beds, groups of 3–7 of a kind with canopies touching; in hedge and screen zones, one closed row; a hedge shape becomes one line along the zone, as wide as the zone. Species take their catalog size, shapes the size you give. They line up with the zone's longest edge and stay clear of paths, terraces, buildings, entries, parking, lawn and the plants already there of their own height layer — ground cover goes under shrubs and trees. Use it for all planting (trees and specimen shrubs too, with `count`) instead of placing plants with add_objects — and plant every zone of a pass in one call. Replies per zone: how many of each it planted, the `cover` counted once (aim 0.85–1.0) and `coverByLayer` (ground < 0.5 m, shrub < 3 m, tree).

coverage.description: Target canopy cover of the zone (default 0.9)

layout.description: groups for beds, row for a hedge or screen; default row when the zone is narrower than 1.6 plants

count.description: An exact number instead of a share, e.g. 1 tree or 3 shrubs

label.description: Its role in the design (and a species the designer named)

notes.description: shape: what the species must bring, for the swap

shape.description: A generic plant shape's form instead of a species

share.description: Relative share of the zone's planted area (default 1): more for the main filler and groundcover, less for accents

tall.description: shape: how tall it grows, m

width.description: shape: its spread (a clump's or mat's diameter), m; default the form's middle size

replace.description: Remove the plants already in the zone first (to redo it)

name: plant_zones
